pairs.question: O Phoebi lecte sacerdos, fallor, an et natum, cum primum haec moenia vidi, bisque duas natas, quantum reminiscor, habebas?
pairs.answer: Non falleris, heros maxime; vidisti natorum quinque parentem, quem nunc (tanta homines rerum inconstantia versat) paene vides orbum.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange between Anchises and Anius. Dropped the speech tag 'tum pius Anchises:' before the question and 'huic Anius niveis circumdata tempora vittis concutiens et tristis ait:' before the answer. Question is Anchises's entire utterance, contiguous, normalized initial capital. Answer begins at 'Non falleris' (directly answering 'fallor, an...?') and ends at the first full stop after 'orbum'; what follows ('quod enim mihi filius absens auxilium...') turns to a new rhetorical question about the absent son and elaborates, so it is cut.
